_metadata.description: API-runtime safety checks that are not generic static-quality policy.

requirements.title: Outbound HTTP calls are bounded and closed
requirements.description: API service code avoids package-level default HTTP clients for production paths, sets explicit timeouts or request contexts, and closes response bodies after successful outbound requests.

validation.notes: Implemented ref: api/internal/validation/runtime_hygiene_test.go. Fixtures cover missing client timeout/default client usage, response body Close, bounded client/request context, and test-file exclusions.

requirements.title: Request context propagates into API-runtime work
requirements.description: Handlers and service methods use request-scoped contexts for outbound calls and long-running work instead of context.Background in production request paths.

validation.notes: Implemented ref: api/internal/validation/runtime_hygiene_test.go. Fixtures cover dropped context via http.NewRequest/context.Background and accepted r.Context-derived timeout propagation.

requirements.title: Long-lived goroutines are cancellable
requirements.description: The validator reports API-started long-lived goroutines with loops that lack context or done-channel cancellation, while short-lived async work and tests are exempted.

validation.notes: Implemented ref: api/internal/validation/runtime_hygiene_test.go. Fixtures cover long-lived loop goroutines without cancellation and context-cancellable loop goroutines.

requirements.title: API service paths use structured logging
requirements.description: API handlers and services avoid fmt.Print/log.Print operational logging in favor of structured logging, while string formatting and startup stderr are allowed.

validation.notes: Implemented ref: api/internal/validation/runtime_hygiene_test.go. Fixtures cover raw log.Printf findings and slog.InfoContext structured logging evidence.
